meta.title: Scaled Dot-Product Attention
meta.subtitle: From query-key scores to weighted values

intro.why_it_matters: Attention lets a model decide which available information is most relevant to each query.
intro.overview: Explore how query and key matrices produce scores, how scaling and row-wise softmax produce weights, and how those weights combine value vectors.

symbols.label: Query matrix
symbols.description: Represents what each token is looking for.

symbols.label: Key matrix
symbols.description: Represents what each token offers for matching.

symbols.label: Value matrix
symbols.description: Contains the vectors combined by the attention weights.

symbols.label: Key dimension
symbols.description: Controls the square-root scaling factor applied to the scores.

guided_explorations.title: Make one match stronger
guided_explorations.instruction: Increase a query entry that aligns with one key and compare the resulting score row.
guided_explorations.observe: Watch how the corresponding normalized weight changes relative to the other weights in that row.
guided_explorations.explanation: A larger query-key dot product receives more weight after row-wise softmax.

guided_explorations.title: Inspect score scaling
guided_explorations.instruction: Change the key dimension and compare the scaled scores and attention weights.
guided_explorations.observe: Larger scaling divisors reduce score magnitudes before softmax.
guided_explorations.explanation: Scaling helps keep large dot products from making the softmax distribution excessively sharp.

limitation.text: This small numerical example explains one attention calculation but does not reproduce a complete Transformer or its learned projections.
